production.note: US model years. First: Acura's 20 March 2023 release is for the '2024 Acura Integra Type S', which 'will launch this summer'. Still on sale: KBB (Sean Tucker, 20 August 2025) reports 'The high-end 2026 Integra Type S starts at $54,595' and 'The 2026 Acura Integra is on sale now' (kbb-2026-integra-pricing).

body.note: AutoGuide (Kyle Patrick, 11 April 2023): 'The pumped-up liftback'; 'The five-door goes on sale this June.' A five-door liftback is recorded as Hatchback.

displacementL.note: Acura's table gives litres only (2.0) and bore x stroke 86.0 / 85.9 mm; no cc figure was found on an opened Acura page. AutoGuide says 'The Civic Type R's 2.0-liter turbocharged four-cylinder sits under the vented hood' (autoguide-2024-integra-type-s-reveal), and Honda's 2023 Civic Type R specifications give 'Displacement 1,996 cc' with the same 86.0 mm x 85.9 mm bore and stroke (honda-us-2023-civic-type-r-specs). 1,996 cc rounds to 2.0.

transmission.note: '6-Speed Manual Transmission (6MT) with Rev-Match Control'; the Type S is offered only with this gearbox.

powerHp.note: 2024 model year. Quote (Horsepower, SAE net @ rpm, Type S column): "320 @ 6,500". Also Acura's 20 March 2023 release: "320 horsepower, 310 lb.-ft. of torque" (acura-us-2024-integra-type-s-320hp).

weightLb.note: 2024 model year; one configuration (6-speed manual). Quote (Curb Weight (lbs.), Integra | Type S columns): "3,084" | "3,219".
